verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents APIs to delete files and CLI/MCP-driven management of rows, files and users, so deletion is possible programmatically, including by agents. Self-hosting gives full control over where data lives, which implies control over its lifecycle. However, no retention policies, TTL/auto-expiry, or retention settings for logs and backups are evidenced. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies/TTL, documented user/account data-deletion (e.g. GDPR erasure) workflows, log and backup retention controls, independent corroboration.
